$schema_doc.purpose: Thin, hand-authored override layer for scripts/build-goal-frontiers.mjs (ADR-0009 §3). The frontier is DERIVED from the KG; only add entries here to correct the derivation. Keys starting with '$' are ignored by the builder.

per_goal_shape.order: string[] — concept_ids pinned to the front of the core, in this order
per_goal_shape.add_core: string[] — force-include these KG concept_ids in the core
per_goal_shape.remove_core: string[] — force-exclude these concept_ids from the core
per_goal_shape.stretch: string[] — explicit stretch set; when present it REPLACES the derived stretch set
per_goal_shape.critical: string[] — force these concepts to goal_critical=true
per_goal_shape.not_critical: string[] — force these concepts to goal_critical=false
